title: NYU法学教授梅丽莎·默里：投票权法案被削弱，少数族裔选区划分面临挑战
speaker: Melissa Murray

segments.en: So David you're exactly right that the voting rights act has been under siege for some time this began in 2013 with Shelby County versus holder which eviscerated the pre clearance regime that required states with the history of suppressive voting laws and practices to first clear any changes in their voting laws with the Department of Justice or a three judge court.
segments.zh: 大卫，你说得对，投票权法案已受到围攻一段时间。这始于2013年的谢尔比县诉霍尔德案，该案废除了预先批准制度，该制度要求有压制性投票法历史的州在修改投票法前，必须先获得司法部或三人法官小组的批准。

segments.en: In the wake of that decision in 2013 states rushed to implement new laws and procedures around voting including more restrictive laws regarding voter ID.
segments.zh: 2013年该裁决后，各州匆忙实施新的投票法律和程序，包括更严格的选民身份法。

segments.en: This new challenge to section two of the voting rights act really hobbles what was left of the voting rights act in terms of a means of keeping states from promulgating more suppressive voting laws.
segments.zh: 对投票权法案第二节的新挑战，严重削弱了该法案剩余部分阻止各州颁布更多压制性投票法的能力。

segments.en: It is made it a lot harder for redistricting to happen in a way that maximizes or optimizes the potential of minority groups to elect candidates of their choice.
segments.zh: 这使得选区划分更难最大化或优化少数群体选举其选择候选人的潜力。

segments.en: And more importantly the court was a little craven and how it decided this on justice Alito did not say he was eliminating or ending section two and said he said he was preserving its central tenants.
segments.zh: 更重要的是，法院的裁决有些怯懦。阿利托大法官并未说他要废除第二节，而是说他在保留其核心原则。

segments.en: And what that means is while section two will no longer be used to challenge racial gerrymanders that disadvantage voters of color.
segments.zh: 这意味着，虽然第二节将不再用于挑战不利于有色人种选民的种族不公正划分选区，

segments.en: It still stands unlikely will be able to be used to challenge redistricting efforts in blue states that try to optimize the voting strength of those constituents.
segments.zh: 但它仍然不太可能用于挑战蓝州试图优化选民投票力量的选区划分努力。
